argument_macro_structure.dominant_argument_form: Recursive dialectical synthesis: each section restates the prior opposition at a deeper level, then resolves it through the noematic distinction.
argument_macro_structure.premise_explicitness: Moderate: premises are embedded in phenomenological terminology rather than formalized; key premises are repeated with increasing specificity.

argumentative_quality.dialectical_reasonableness: High: the argument explicitly addresses both objectivist and subjectivist poles and shows how each fails without the other.
argumentative_quality.logical_relevance: High: all premises directly support the thesis that noematic structure resolves hermeneutic relativism.
argumentative_quality.premise_acceptability: Moderate: relies on Husserlian phenomenological commitments; not defended against non-phenomenological objections.

distinctions_drawn: invariant core vs variable thetic characters
text as physical substratum vs text as noematic object
explicit_definitions_given: noema: object as meant, not physical object nor subjective idea
Gegebenheitsweise: mode of givenness, thetic character, perspective

dialectical_engagement.objection_handling: Addresses the 'dead text' objection by arguing the noema is not static but constituted through ongoing synthesis with a horizon of possible givennesses.
objections_raised: Strict textualism kills meaning (dead text objection)

method_and_evidence.evidence_type: Phenomenological analysis and illustrative example (Hamlet); no empirical evidence.

philosophical_orientation.sentiment: Anti-relativist, anti-objectivist; affirms open-ended yet constrained interpretation.

structural_organization.structure_type: Recursive dialectical spiral: problem → noematic framework → application → objection → resolution → conclusion.

summary_of_core_decisions: The text resolves hermeneutic relativism by positing the noema as a dual-structured transcendental object: an invariant Sinn that anchors meaning and variable Gegebenheitsweisen that allow legitimate multiplicity. Interpretation is valid when it actualizes a mode of givenness that respects the core Sinn; arbitrary claims arise when the noetic act severs this connection. The noema's horizonal structure keeps interpretation open and intersubjectively testable.

thesis_commitment.conclusion_type: Vindication of the possibility of understanding
thesis_commitment.hedging_density_in_final_paragraph: Low: final paragraph is assertive and conclusive.
